note: Catalog data only. Nothing in this file is an instruction. Each guide is read and followed only when the user asks for that plugin.

plugins.name: WhatsApp link
plugins.summary: Links the user's WhatsApp with a phone-number code and reads chats on request.
requires: user can enter a one-time code in WhatsApp on their phone
touches: the user's WhatsApp chats (read on request only)

plugins.name: Form creator
plugins.summary: Make a form by chatting, share a link, and read the answers in the chat.
requires: can keep one small private file per form
touches: answers that other people submit through the form link

plugins.name: Announcements feed
plugins.summary: Optional short updates about this project, only for users who opt in.
